chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Old Trafford, 2011. United and City, one-all. Nani on the right. His cross hits a defender and loops up. Rooney... overhead kick! Top corner!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Slow motion. The deflection takes the speed off the ball. Rooney watches it, turns his body, jumps early, swings his right foot over his head.

chapters.label: Behind the net
chapters.text: Joe Hart can't move. Two-one, and Old Trafford goes wild!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Beginners: only practise on soft mats, with a coach. The secret is timing and body shape. Watch the ball, jump early, and land on your hands and back.
